decision.title: Public file upload for user profile
decision.context: Users can upload profile pictures that are later displayed publicly.

statement.technical_goal: Allow users to upload profile images with minimal latency and simple validation.
statement.assumptions: Uploaded files are images and will be processed by an image service before being served.
statement.conscious_simplifications: We rely on file extension and MIME type checks only in the first version.
statement.non_negotiables: Uploaded files must not be executed. Files must be stored outside application root.
statement.accepted_worst_case: Malicious file may be uploaded and stored, but not executed or served directly.
